title: Reporting Statements: No Tense Backshifting in Hungarian

sections.title: Preserving Utterance Tense
sections.content: Unlike English or Spanish, Hungarian reported speech does not shift tenses backwards into the past. The subordinate clause introduced by *azt mondta, hogy...* retains the exact grammatical tense of the original utterance relative to that moment.

items.spanish: Péter: „Beteg vagyok.” -> Péter azt mondta, hogy beteg.
items.english: Peter: 'I am sick.' -> Peter said that he was sick (lit. is sick).

items.spanish: Anna: „Holnap elutazom.” -> Anna azt mondta, hogy másnap elutazik.
items.english: Anna: 'I will travel tomorrow.' -> Anna said that she would travel the next day.

items.spanish: Gábor: „Megírtam a cikket.” -> Gábor azt mondta, hogy megírta a cikket.
items.english: Gabor: 'I wrote the article.' -> Gabor said that he had written the article.
